# revkit's own processors (docs/processors.md, "revkit's own processors"):
# SLEIGH specs Ghidra doesn't ship, compiled with rk-sleigh into
# ${REVKIT_PROCESSORS_DIR}/<processor>/data/languages beside their .ldefs,
# .pspec and .cspec, and installed to share/revkit/processors (cmake/install.cmake). lift::initialize
# adds each to Ghidra's (runtime::processors_dir).
#
#   EVM   Ethereum Virtual Machine bytecode (docs/evm.md); evm.slaspec is
#         generated by EVM/gen_slaspec.py and committed.

if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
  message(STATUS "revkit processors: cross-compiling, rk-sleigh can't run here: no EVM processor")
  return()
endif()

set(_outputs)
# Under the sanitizers rk-sleigh runs instrumented at build time: UBSan
# gets the vendored engine's suppressions (tools/sanitizers/ubsan.supp; the
# SLEIGH compiler's label check casts before it tests a symbol's type),
# else its report's own allocations fail the step as LeakSanitizer leaks.
set(_rk_sleigh_env)
if(REVKIT_SANITIZE STREQUAL "address")
  set(_rk_sleigh_env ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env
      "UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1:suppressions=${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/sanitizers/ubsan.supp")
endif()
# rk_processor(PROCESSOR SLASPEC FILES...): compile SLASPEC, copy FILES.
function(rk_processor proc slaspec)
  set(_src ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${proc}/data/languages)
  set(_dst ${REVKIT_PROCESSORS_DIR}/${proc}/data/languages)
  get_filename_component(_stem ${slaspec} NAME_WE)
  add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${_dst}/${_stem}.sla
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${_dst}
    COMMAND ${_rk_sleigh_env} ${CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR} $<TARGET_FILE:rk-sleigh> ${_src}/${slaspec} ${_dst}/${_stem}.sla
    DEPENDS rk-sleigh ${_src}/${slaspec}
    COMMENT "SLEIGH ${proc}/${slaspec}"
    VERBATIM)
  set(_out ${_dst}/${_stem}.sla)
  foreach(f ${ARGN})
    add_custom_command(
      OUTPUT ${_dst}/${f}
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different ${_src}/${f} ${_dst}/${f}
      DEPENDS ${_src}/${f}
      VERBATIM)
    list(APPEND _out ${_dst}/${f})
  endforeach()
  set(_outputs ${_outputs} ${_out} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

rk_processor(EVM evm.slaspec evm.ldefs evm.pspec evm.cspec)

add_custom_target(revkit_processors ALL DEPENDS ${_outputs})
